st: What do Playboy, Steve Jobs, Jesus and ChatGPT have in common?

sec.t: ff.48.1 Everyone is talking about ChatGPT
sec.p: ChatGPT : 2023 = NFTs : 2022. Too bad it all came crashing down afterwards. Unlike “non-fungible” digital assets, what's happened is staggering:

sec.t: ff.48.2 Steve Jobs and the Playboy interview
sec.p: In the chart above there was obviously the iPhone too. And that brings us to Apple. Let me explain: with prompting, you can convince ChatGPT to impersonate Thales, Leonardo da Vinci or Darwin (or anyone else who has put their thinking out there).

sec.t: ff.48.3 AI, jack of all trades
sec.p: A roundup of more serious applications.

Numbers lie. Wolfram Alpha, a little scared, snitched to the teacher that ChatGPT tried to copy. Jokes aside, when it comes to maths, the bot isn't top of the class (after all, it “studied” for another subject: finding the most “truthful” way to continue a sentence)

rel: ff.54 I got dumped by GPT-4
